messages:
Diego R: Hey team — first day here as an SDR. I don't have access to HubSpot or Dialpad yet and can't find the SDR one-pager/battle cards. Who do I ping for invites and where's the latest call script? Thanks!

Priya (Sales Ops): Welcome Diego! I can sort HubSpot + Dialpad. What email did you sign up with? Also here's the onboarding bundle: https://redwood.link/onboard-sdr (contains playbooks, deck, and battle cards).

Diego R: diego@redwood.ai — thanks Priya.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Diego R to #sales! You were added to the SDR group and assigned the "Buddy: Sam". Check your inbox for invites.

Priya (Sales Ops): Invites sent for HubSpot and Dialpad just now. Check spam and then accept. I'm adding you to the "SDR - Outbound" team in HubSpot — if you still see nothing, ping me here and I'll escalate.

Alex (IT): @Diego R I provisioned VPN access and enforced MFA on your account. If Dialpad login fails, try SSO via: https://login.redwood.com -> "Sign in with SSO". If app throws an error, send me the screenshot and I'll clear caches.

Diego R: HubSpot invite arrived but after I accept I only see a blank "No records" screen.

Priya (Sales Ops): Try logging out and opening in incognito first. If that doesn't work I just added you to the correct pipeline and team — you should now see "Outbound - SDR" and a set of test contacts under "My Contacts". Confirm?

Diego R: I can see the Outbound pipeline now, thanks! Dialpad still shows "invite pending" though.

Priya (Sales Ops): Dialpad sometimes takes a minute. I resent the invite and bumped you into the "SDR - Voice" group. If it still shows pending in 10 min, @Alex can provision a manual account.

Sam (SDR): Hey @Diego R — happy to help. Quick heads up on calls: use the "Openers v3" script (Confluence) and keep the first 30s focused on problem discovery. I'll shadow you at 3:00pm PT today for 20 minutes. Prep: skim the battle card titled "Pricing Objections" and bring two questions.

Emma (CS): @Diego R welcome — since you'll be handing leads to CS, here's the handoff checklist: https://redwood.link/cs-handoff. Make sure you include the qualification notes and any recorded clips. Also feel free to add me to your calendar if you want a 15-min dry run before handing off.

Diego R: Got the links and 3pm works. Appreciate the quick help everyone — catching up on the bundle now. :party_parrot:

Priya (Sales Ops): One more thing — sales collateral (one-pagers, pricing grid, customer case studies) live in Drive > Sales > Collateral. Link copied to the onboarding bundle. If you want printed quick-cards let me know and I can order a pack for you.

Alex (IT): Dialpad invite finally accepted on my end. If you still can't call, reinstall the desktop app or use the web client at https://dialpad.redwood.ai.

Diego R: All set now — HubSpot, Dialpad, and bundle. Thanks again, see you at 3pm.

Sam (SDR): Sweet — see you then.
